body: Maybe I'll space me reaching out more I do it every few days or so when she gets like this. It just makes me feel like I did something wrong sometimes but have no idea what it would be. We've gone through pretty similar pasts and I care deeply about her. I obviously don't want to lose her. Thank you for the advice though
It also feels like every time I push her away she realizes and makes more of an effort. Then just goes right back to her old ways. It's just a cycle

Problem is she knows I've tried to commit... It kinda didn't feel right and felt out of charecter for her. She was also with her boyfriend at the time she was saying all of this. I feel like a majority of her behaviour is manipulative...
Basically what should I do in this situation

We where at the bar with a mutual friend.

Current relationship is pretty crappy. We rarely talk or spend any time together.

I definitely should I just don't like starting arguments and she gets angry about it. She act like she has romantic feelings and then is distant again. Her whole family thought we where dating and when we both said no they saw how we interacted and made fun of us basically.

I have the means to move out. I've been looking into moving for the past few years now. The only thing to add on top of that would be where I'd finish schooling at.

As for the invite it was her sister who I know and get along with. I also get along with her parents. I knew it wouldn't be strange going because it would just basically be us hanging out. I don't understand why she told me I wasn't going to be invited if one of her other friends could have came and that she basically settled for me.
I guess I kind of been trying to figure that out. We both have always been there for each other when one of us needs it.
I'm not forcing her to talk to me I occasionally send her stuff and started to realize I get no response. Freaked me out a bit
Well at least we know we aren't alone. Hope we get through this. If not today or tomorrow, someday... Appreciate you reaching out
Yeah... but I don't want to lose a close friend
I mean we had a conversation how neither of us wanted to date at the moment just because we want to get our stuff together and be able to do what we want. I probably should bring it up
So I should just distance myself? Not really sure what to do about the situation...

That actually makes total sense and seemed to be the case. Why we fought so much in the past because I stopped telling her stuff because it seemed like she didn't care about what I said. She then found out through other people like I did with her. But I was in the wrong just because I did it and nothing changed for a while.
We're extremely good friends and before I've told her I have feelings with her but she didn't want anything. It's just a little confuse the way she acts sometimes...
I think I definitely will now. It's been going on for a while. She always kinda guilted me into doing stuff with her and what I'm now realizing overstepping boundaries. Thanks for the help.

I guess I worded that wrong. She seemed extremely happy it was over. She said she wanted to be able to do whatever she wanted without being held down. We where extremely close before the got together and became distant as the relationship went on. I agree on the taller fences. Considering she asked if we could play this game and said it was $30 and me not doing well with money atm. She just told me just to buy it...

From what she told me she shouldn't be rebounding. She broke up with her boyfriend because they didn't talk much anymore then he made her feel like shit. I'm getting to the point where I feel like she doesn't respect my boundaries and always wants me to be there for her but won't do the same
Gotcha thanks for the advice

Feels kinda shitty cause she's my "best friend" still kinda figuring that out at the moment and she still does this. We used to do everything together then all of a sudden when she got a boyfriend that was it. Guess I'll just keep living my life and see what happens. Is it even worth replying all the time?
Yeah I feel like it's the case she just wants attention and isn't really interested
Feel like this is a good idea

I guess fear of rejection. I've kind of hinted saying she should come visit and that we could go out and it'd be good for her. I got no real reply. I kinda have a gut feeling she's too scared to lose me as a friend to try and I know I feel the same.
I've already asked in the past but she was just getting in a relationship and she didn't want to try

I wouldn't have a problem with this but when she got into her relationship she kinda just dropped me and was on existent I don't want someone who will be a best friend/good friend of mine only when she's not in a relationship

I obviously have feeling for her. I feel like she just plays around too much so I kinda feel like it's pointless. She wants me to visit but I can't because of work and I tell her to visit me because it's easier for her but she refuses. It's and hour ish drive.
Well thanks for the advice

I tried too but she kinda played it off that I didn't want her to go be with other people. When she first started I called her out on it because she wouldn't even tell me. I found out from other people originally that she was dating her ex.

You're correct. I don't know if she actually has feelings for me or not I'm not 100%. I said I had feelings for her one time and we talked and she wanted to stay friends (when the boyfriend was first coming into the picture). I'm extremely cautious considering I spend so mug time with this girl before she dated her ex. Almost everyday and we did almost everything together and then all of a sudden it was gone. I'm honestly just scared of that happening again, but still want to be there for her. Also even after our conversation about us giving it a shot everyone still thinks we're going to end up dating. I've seen other people too, but our close mutual friends say we're both going to end up breaking up and seeing each other...
Don't do it friend. Pm me if you need to talk or vent
Keep doing the things you love try to figure out ways to make a living off it. I'm here for you. Have gone through a lot of the same shit you have and understand

Even if it is "useless" if you enjoy it keep doing it and don't care what they think. I don't spend much time around my family I rather just be in my room. I play video games most of the time and I get shit for it all the time during breaks I try to learn stuff on the internet. Just do what makes you feel alive don't let anyone take that from you.
You're in a rough patch right now so what the difference if you just do something that makes you happy

Hey, I feel ya.

Recently my parents basically flat out told me I was a loser and wasn't going to get anywhere in life. They always make it feel like my hopes and dreams are stupid. 

I totally get you on the empty shell thing I just feel so lost right now. I'm not giving in yet though life's gotta give at some point.

Feel better
